Vocabulary

young person in the process of developing into an adult

information or evidence that proves that something is true or that someone has committed a crime

software that blocks pop-up apps and websites and allows users to set timers which limit their amount of screen time

immersive video games and social media which are designed to manipulate human psychology

someone who is very familiar and comfortable using digital technology and computers because they have grown up with them

title: Open NotebookLM: Turn PDFs into Podcasts!
description:
Developer Gabriel Chua has released his answer to Google's increasingly popular PDF to podcast converter notebookLM. Open NotebookLM replicates Google's capabilities by combining various open-source models.

For those unfamiliar with Google's AI experiment, NotebookLM is a research assistant platform that takes user-uploaded documents and uses Gemini 1.5 pro to offer a notetaking first approach to interacting with information found in the document. NotebookLM generates a summary of all documents uploaded to the user's notebook and allows users to ask questions about the material. Once the information is processed, NotebookLM answers with appropriate citations from the uploaded documents. However, the most impressive feature is the ability to generate podcasts based on the documents they have uploaded. The Gemini-generated podcast takes AI-selected information from the documents. It creates an audio file of a discussion between two speakers on subjects found in the material, with audio clips ranging between five and thirty minutes. However, some users may be hesitant to upload material to a proprietary LLM, which is where Open NotebookLM differs.

With a simple and straightforward UI, Open NotebookLM was built using various open-source and text-to-speech models to turn PDFs into podcasts. For processing the PDF, Open NotebookLM uses Llama 3.1 with a character limit of 100 thousand. Although not quite as capable as Gemini, MeloTTS provides solid text-to-speech performance for the project, and users can adjust the tone of the AI between "fun" and "formal." Additionally, Open NotebookLM supports just over ten languages, with Spanish, French, and German among the options. Currently, users can try the project on  Chua's Hugging face page or build it locally from the resources available on the project's GitHub repo.

title: US Can't Win Tech War and Trade War At the Same Time: Navin Girishankar
description:
The future of the one of the world’s biggest trading relationships hangs in the balance after President Donald Trump’s tariff war sparked a standoff between the US and China.

While Trump stepped back from the cliff edge for most countries — announcing on April 9 a 90-day pause on much of his “reciprocal” tariff agenda — he doubled down on China, increasing the new levy on its imports since he returned to the White House to 145%. Vowing to “fight to the end,” China responded by hiking its new duties on shipments from America to 84%.

The spiraling tariffs mark a dramatic step-up in trade tensions between the two countries. Prior to 2025, the average import taxes charged by each side on the other were less than 20%, even after the first trade war in Trump’s previous term in office. 

Navin Girishankar, President of the Economic Security and Technology Department at the Center for Strategic and International Studies and former Senior Official at the US Department of Commerce, joins Balance of Power to discuss the impact of Trump's tariffs on China on the US technology industry.

title: Top Technology Podcasts to Tune Into in 2024
description:
Summary: Discover some of the best technology podcasts available in 2024. Stay informed and entertained with insights from industry leaders and tech enthusiasts.
---

In today's fast-paced digital world, staying updated on the latest in technology is crucial. Podcasts offer a convenient way to keep up with industry trends, expert opinions, and deep dives into tech innovations. Whether you're a seasoned tech professional or a curious enthusiast, there's a podcast out there for you. Here are some of the best technology podcasts to consider in 2024:

Reply All
Reply All is a long-running podcast that explores modern life through the lens of technology. Hosted by PJ Vogt and Alex Goldman, the show delves into intriguing stories about how technology affects our lives, often in unexpected ways.

Techmeme Ride Home
For those who want a daily dose of tech news, Techmeme Ride Home is perfect. Hosted by Brian McCullough, this podcast provides a concise summary of the day's most important tech stories, making it ideal for busy professionals.

Accidental Tech Podcast
Hosted by Marco Arment, Casey Liss, and John Siracusa, the Accidental Tech Podcast (ATP) offers in-depth discussions on Apple products, software development, and general tech news. The hosts' expertise and chemistry make for an engaging listen.

The Vergecast
Produced by The Verge, The Vergecast covers the week in tech news, gadgets, and industry trends. Hosted by Nilay Patel, Dieter Bohn, and Paul Miller, this podcast provides insightful analysis and entertaining commentary.

Darknet Diaries
Hosted by Jack Rhysider, Darknet Diaries explores the dark side of the internet and cybersecurity. Each episode features stories about hackers, cybercrime, and digital espionage, making it a gripping listen for those interested in cybersecurity.

StartUp Podcast
A product of Gimlet Media, StartUp Podcast chronicles the highs and lows of starting a business. Although it covers various industries, it often focuses on tech startups, providing valuable insights for aspiring entrepreneurs.

Waveform: The MKBHD Podcast
Tech reviewer Marques Brownlee (MKBHD) hosts Waveform, where he discusses the latest in tech, gadgets, and innovations. With guest interviews and expert opinions, this podcast is perfect for gadget lovers and tech enthusiasts.

CodeNewbie
Aimed at people new to coding, CodeNewbie offers inspiring stories and advice from developers of all levels. Host Saron Yitbarek interviews guests who share their coding journeys and provide tips for those entering the tech field.

How I Built This
Hosted by Guy Raz, How I Built This dives into the stories behind some of the world's best-known companies. While not exclusively tech-focused, many episodes feature tech entrepreneurs, offering valuable insights into building successful tech businesses.

The AI Alignment Podcast
For those interested in artificial intelligence, The AI Alignment Podcast offers deep dives into AI research, ethics, and safety. Hosted by the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, it features discussions with leading AI experts.

Conclusion
Podcasts are an excellent way to stay informed about the latest developments in technology. Whether you're interested in daily news updates, in-depth analysis, or inspiring stories from tech entrepreneurs, there's a podcast for you. Happy listening!

title: Edit Podcasts Faster and More Affordable: Our Studio's Secret Weapon
description:
Podcast editing can be a real time-suck, especially when it comes to video podcasts and multi-camera videos. But we've found a solution that speeds up the process and makes it more affordable for our clients. Our secret weapon is the Blackmagic ATEM Extreme ISO and an app called MixEffect.

The ATEM Extreme ISO allows us to control all three studio cameras and feed them into the app, MixEffect. One of the biggest time savers is MixEffect's VFA (Video follows audio) mode. This means that when someone talks into a microphone, the camera automatically switches to them. And if the audio is too quiet or too loud, the camera switches to a wide shot. This saves us a ton of time during editing.

The recording is saved as a DaVinci Resolve session, with all the edits already built in and adjustable. This means that if the automatic switching made a mistake, we can fix it in post-production. And that's how we save a ton of time and make the editing process more affordable for our clients.

Watch now and unlock AI podcasting!

Meta has officially launched NotebookLlama, an open-source implementation of the popular generate-a-podcast feature found in Google's NotebookLM. This innovative project leverages Meta's proprietary Llama models to process and transform text files into engaging, podcast-style discussions.

Key Features:

1. Text-to-Podcast Conversion: NotebookLlama can generate conversational audio digests from uploaded text files.
2. Back-and-Forth Dialogue: The model creates a natural, podcast-like exchange between two virtual participants.
3. Customizable: Users can adjust parameters to control the tone, style, and content of the generated podcast.
4. Open-Source: Meta's release allows developers to modify and improve the code.

How it Works:

1. Text Upload: Users upload a text file to the NotebookLlama platform.
2. Processing: Meta's Llama models analyze and process the text.
3. Audio Generation: NotebookLlama generates a podcast-style audio file.
4. Customization: Users can refine the output using various parameters.

Potential Applications:

1. Podcasting: Create automated podcasts from written content.
2. Audiobooks: Transform written texts into engaging audio experiences.
3. Education: Generate interactive, conversational study materials.
4. Accessibility: Enhance text-to-speech capabilities for visually impaired users.

Comparison to NotebookLM:

1. Similar Functionality: Both generate podcast-style audio from text.
2. Different Models: NotebookLlama uses Meta's Llama models, while NotebookLM relies on Google's.
3. Open-Source: NotebookLlama's open-source nature allows for community-driven development.

Conclusion:

NotebookLlama marks a significant milestone in AI-driven audio generation. By making this technology open-source, Meta encourages collaboration and innovation, paving the way for exciting applications in podcasting, education, and accessibility.

Watch this video tutorial to learn how to listen to podcasts on your iPhone. We'll show you just how easy it is to enjoy podcasts at home or on the go with the free Podcasts app for iOS.

To listen to podcasts on your iPhone, open the app store. Search for the podcasts app. Tap the download icon. When the download is complete, open the app. Browse featured podcasts or search for a specific one if you know what you want to find. Tap Search. Enter the name of the podcast you’re looking for.

Tap a podcast to open it. Now you can choose the episode you want to listen to. Tap an episode, then tap the Play button to listen to it. Use the buttons at the bottom to pause, play, rewind, or fast forward. Tap the subscribe button to add a podcast to your library. Tap the Library button to access any podcasts you’ve subscribed to.

title: The Rise of Podcasts: 3 Reasons Why They're So Popular
description:
Why are podcasts becoming so popular?

Podcasts are becoming increasingly popular for a few key reasons. First, they're convenient. You can listen to them while you're working out, driving, cooking, or doing other activities. You don't have to sit down and watch a video, so you can multitask. You can listen to podcasts on a variety of platforms, including podcasting apps like Spotify and Apple Podcasts, or on YouTube.

Second, podcasts are a great way to learn new things. There are podcasts on every topic imaginable, from history to science to pop culture. You can learn about anything you're interested in, without having to spend hours reading a book or watching a documentary.

Third, podcasts are a great way to connect with other people. There are podcasts for every type of community, from sports fans to book lovers to parents. You can find podcasts on entrepreneurship, success stories, business ideas, current affairs, news & politics, and a lot more.

If you're looking for a convenient, informative, and engaging way to learn and connect with others, then you should definitely check out podcasts.
